earnings.title: October 20, 2026
highlights: Net income was $224 million, or $1.62 per diluted earnings per share.
This compares to net income of $226 million, or $1.62 per diluted share in the prior year period.
Adjusted net income was $286 million, or $2.07 per diluted earnings per share.

Adjusted net income excludes $61 million of after-tax adjustments, or $0.45 per diluted share, which relates to costs associated with the company's global restructuring initiative and the planned separation of the company's Automotive and Industrial businesses.
Sales were $6.5 billion, a 4.2% increase compared to $6.3 billion in the same period of the prior year.

quotes.text: Our third quarter performance demonstrates the strength of our market leading businesses and our teams’ continued focus on serving customers and executing our strategic priorities.
quotes.by: Will Stengel, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: Narrows 2026 Outlook for Adjusted EPS to $7.50 to $7.75 from $7.50 to $8.00

items.heading: Our business will be adversely affected if demand for our products slows.
Our results of operations, revenue, and supply chain could be materially affected as a result of a bankruptcy, insolvency or other credit failures of a significant customer or vendor.
The impact of geopolitical conflicts may adversely affect our business and results of operations.

If we experience a security breach, if our internal information systems fail to function properly or if we are unsuccessful in implementing, integrating or upgrading our information systems, our business operations could be materially affected.
